shots.p: close-up of a smiling man swearing an oath with raised hand in a gathering, but his shadow on the wall twisted and turned away
a man holding a polished shield before his face as a mask in a crowd, blocking others from a bright path behind him
a man stepping into light and then back into shadow at a doorway, his face divided in half, uncertain dusk
well-dressed elegant men speaking eloquently in a majlis, then a cutaway to hollow wooden planks propped lifeless against a wall
close-up of the same well-dressed man flinching nervously at every sound outside his tent at night, fearful eyes, lamplight
men in a doorway turning their heads away arrogantly and walking off as others gently invite them back inside, dusk light
a dry cracked riverbed where rain falls but the ground remains barren, grey sky, quiet hopelessness
a few men refusing to give bread to needy travelers at a well, while in the background rich storehouses of grain and rain clouds fill the sky
arrogant men pointing at humble believers at a town gate, then the same believers standing firm and dignified as the sun rises behind them
a father absorbed counting gold in a room, his children pulling at his sleeves, while the evening prayer call echoes from a minaret outside
an old man on a sickbed reaching weakly toward a chest of coins, regret in his eyes, dim lamp, family gathered quietly
contrast shot, a healthy younger man giving bread to poor children at his doorstep at dawn, warm golden light, gentle smile
an hourglass running its last grains on a wooden table, a candle burning down to its end, quiet dim room
